facts.fact: WBBA case study says the ACE submarine cable's first-mile network is in service in Gambia, with GAMTEL's ECOWAN and NBN backbones; it reports international bandwidth rising from 10 Gbps in 2015 to 220+ Gbps in 2020-2022. Document is undated; published date 2024-05 used.

note: Wholesale access described is on GAMTEL's domestic backbone, not stated for the landing station or international capacity, so no access fact.
